summary: Iter-12 verified Task Edit/Delete/Bulk-Delete role permissions. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests PASSED (test_tasks_bulk_delete_iter12.py). Frontend spot-check on Expo web preview PASSED for admin, manager and employee roles. Scenarios 1/2/3/4 all PASS. No regressions observed.

scenario_results.1_patch_tasks_role_perms: PASS — admin+manager 200 with title updated; employee 403 with title unchanged; invalid tid 404
scenario_results.2_delete_tasks_admin_only: PASS — manager 403, employee 403 (task still exists), admin 200 {deleted:1}, follow-up GET 404
scenario_results.3_bulk_delete_admin_only: PASS — manager 403, employee 403 (all 3 intact); admin 200 {deleted:2} c1/c2 gone c3 alive; empty {ids:[]} → {deleted:0}; nonexistent ids → {deleted:0}; c3 cleanup delete 1
scenario_results.4_route_ordering: PASS — POST /api/tasks/bulk-delete with {ids:[]} returned 200 {deleted:0}; route not shadowed by /{tid} or /{tid}/attachments
scenario_results.frontend_admin: PASS — enter-select visible, bulk-bar appears, row check-<id> renders, tap 2 → '2 selected' header, bulk-delete enabled; select-all selects entire filtered set (71 tasks incl. off-screen virtualized) and toggles back to 0; exit-select removes bulk-bar; row edit-<id>/del-<id> visible; tap edit-<id> navigates to /tasks/new?edit_id=<id>, header 'Edit Task' shown, in-title pre-filled with existing title (UI-Iter12-Task-C)
scenario_results.frontend_employee: PASS — enter-select NOT rendered; edit-<taskId>/del-<taskId> NOT rendered on any row
scenario_results.frontend_manager: PASS — enter-select NOT rendered; edit-<taskId> IS rendered on rows; del-<taskId> NOT rendered

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in server.py is correct: POST /api/tasks/bulk-delete (line 1612) is registered BEFORE DELETE /api/tasks/{tid} (line 1621) and POST /api/tasks/{tid}/attachments (line 1627), preventing collision.
bulk_delete_tasks correctly filters out empty ids and returns {deleted:0} for empty/nonexistent inputs — safe no-op behaviour matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-clean their created tasks (BulkTest-Iter12-A/B, BulkTest-C1/C2/C3). UI spot-check seeded 3 tasks (UI-Iter12-Task-A/B/C) which were subsequently deleted via API cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For future tests: (1) After admin login, to log out via UI you must first navigate to the /tabs/dashboard (or home) — the More tab click can fail from a detail screen like /tasks/new. Alternate approach used here: navigate directly to /login and localStorage.clear() before login. (2) Playwright counts of testID^="check-tsk_" reflect only currently rendered FlatList rows (~46), while 'select-all' selects the entire filtered dataset in state (71 in DB) — so header count > rendered checkbox count is expected, not a bug. (3) React Native <Pressable disabled={...}> on web renders opacity but no HTML disabled attr — Playwright .is_disabled() may return False even when logically disabled; assert via style/opacity or by clicking + observing no-op.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature under review works correctly end-to-end.
